title: Clipper: clipfix.exe swapped a wallet address on your clipboard
summary: it replaced the bait Bitcoin address ABA put on the clipboard with its own

program.name: clipfix.exe
program.signature: None. Nobody vouches for this file.

reasons: it swapped a wallet address on the clipboard
checklist: Don't send crypto from this Mac until it's cleaned. Anywhere you must paste an address, compare every character with the real one on another device.
From another device, check your recent crypto transfers. One sent to an address you don't recognise went to the attacker: contact the exchange's or wallet's support right away.
Clippers often come with a stealer. From another device (your phone), change your passwords, email first, and move crypto to a NEW wallet created on a clean device.

Strongly consider erasing the Mac and reinstalling macOS (back up your documents, not your apps): stealers often drop more malware. At the least, remove anything you don't recognise from System Settings > General > Login Items.
Look the file up on VirusTotal from another device: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/c0ffee5a1e9b2d7f48a3e61b90d5c27f3e8a14b6d02c9f75e1a3b8d4c6f20e19
